text.p: - The Slovenian government's lineup proposed by prime minister-designate Janez Drnovsek on Friday will be presented to a parliamentary board throughout the week. Hearings are due to start on Tuesday.

- Slovenians have so far exchanged 86 percent of 576 billion tolars ($3.49 billion) worth of privatisation vouchers for shares in companies. The process which started in 1994 is expected to be completed by middle of this year, the country's privatisation agency said.
- The ministry of economic affairs said that 3.6 billion tolars of state guarantees for loans are available for exporting companies in the first half of the year.
- Slovenian teenage ski jumper Primoz Peterka managed to keep his overall World Cup leading position although he missed a Japanese tour over the last two weekends.
- Miran Rauter won silver and David De Costa bronze for Slovenia in the downhill race of the international students' games of Universiade in South Korean Muju.
- Minister of Economic Affairs Janko Dezelak will attend a two-day seminar in Brussels on EU trade protection measures against central and eastern European countries.
- Car insurance premiums for drivers under 25 and previous offenders will increase by 35 percent from April 1.
